name: Thorkell
subtitle: Jomsviking Commander
description: Towering Brawler that deals increased damage while injured.
lore: A ferocious war-leader, Thorkell the Tall engaged in multiple battles on multiple sides. He was a raider, mercenary, and conqueror, feared by many, trusted by few. While he currently defends Asgard and conducts raids on its rivals, other Asgardians watch for the day Thorkell turns on them, whether because someone makes him a better offer or due to his own ambitions.
divinity_generator: Gain [40] Divinity when inflicting damage to an enemy under [Bleed].

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +25%, Armor Multiplier +15%, Weapon Multiplier +15%

skills.name: Mighty Cleave
skills.description: Place [mechanic:sharpen-ii] on this hero for 2 turns, then attack all enemies (15%HP+120%ATK) with 80% chance to place 2 stacks of [mechanic:bleed] on each target.

skills.name: Whirlwind Fury
skills.description: Attack all enemies (5%HP+50%ATK)3 times. Each hit has a 80% chance to place 1 stacks of [mechanic:bleed] on each target. If the target has more than 5 stacks of [mechanic:bleed] also Heal this hero for 20% of the damage inflicted.

skills.name: Double Swing
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (8%HP+90%ATK)2 times. Each hit as a 50% to place 1 stack of [mechanic:bleed] on the target.

skills.name: Bloodlust
skills.description:
This hero gains effects depending on the stacks of [mechanic:bleed] on the enemy team:
At 5 Stacks: +20% Increased Damage
At 10 Stacks: Steals +10% Turn Meter when attacking
At 20 Stacks: -30% Damage Received
skills.awakening_bonus: At 20 Stacks: Also attacks inflict additional damage 200%ATK to all enemies under [Bleed] which cannot critical hit.
